items.title: Trace algebraic branching programs are not closed: an explicit degeneration separated by tangent-space flow dimensions
items.author: Markus Bläser; Christian Ikenmeyer; Meena Mahajan; Anurag Pandey; Nitin Saurabh
items.source_version: CCC2020 officialcomplete24-page CCBY3.0Unported publication; mainTheorem4 and entireSections5–8 traceABP degeneration/conciseness/tangent/flow authorproof, with requiredintro/Section3 notation.
items.difficulty_reason: The construction produces a border point through parity-weighted trace paths, then excludes both singular and invertible matrix actions: flattenings handle conciseness while tangent summands are identified with flow spaces, whose extra parity constraint forces an orbit-dimension drop.
